search_window.basis: From the verified preceding supplementary Care Line heartbeat completion to the current execution; late-indexed recalls screened, with production national collection remaining authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: U.S., DC, Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa. Supplementary watch for hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary-care service loss, emergency/rural loss, ambulance/air-medical/base loss, CMS provider/CLIA actions, and concrete effective restorations.

coverage_notes.screening: CMS first, followed by exactly twelve bounded topical targeted searches. No independently verified, previously unrecorded qualifying healthcare-access change identified for the covered window; current-day material found was planning, training, commentary or non-service-change reporting, while concrete closures and restorations were older.
excluded_examples: October 25 Minnesota rural obstetrics fellowship report is a workforce/training initiative, not a newly effective service loss or restoration: https://www.mprnews.org/story/2026/10/25/rural-labor-and-delivery-get-boost-from-university-of-minnesota-medical-school-fellowship

September 22 Hawai'i Kula Hospital restoration announcement lacks an effective reopening date; the emergency department remains closed: https://mauinow.com/2026/09/22/state-maui-health-and-kaiser-permanente-announce-restoration-and-reopening-plans-for-kula-hospital/
Historical hospital closures and previous watch findings, non-U.S. results, financial projections, proposals without actual service change, and nonhealthcare coverage excluded.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search results and Sunday local reporting may lag real-world events. Absence of supplementary findings is not evidence that no service change occurred. Authoritative production national collector and its full review queue were not independently read; no duplication claim against that queue.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, alteration of primary collector, schedule change, or task disablement.
